generation_lifts.interpretation: generation 1 is the q^3 slice selected by the threshold transport direction
generation 2 is the q^3 slice selected by the rank/opposition transport direction
generation 3 is the q^3 slice selected by the carrier transport direction

theorem_statement: The Fano transport directions give the three-generation slicing of the W33 H1 carrier. One W33 edge color has 80=q^4-1 edges; adding the closure state gives q^4=81. The q-axis of three Fano directions slices this q^4 carrier into q slices of size q^3, so H1(W33)=81=3*27, one q^3 generation per Fano direction.
interpretive_note: This ties the edge-color lift to the homology/generation count. The same Fano directions that lift to the three 80-edge colors also label the three 27-dimensional generation slices inside the completed q^4 carrier.
